name: Defensive Archery
body:
You are adept at making shots while dodging attackers trying to stop you.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity triggered by your ranged attack.

Special: A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
